Critical breakages and serious vulnerabilities response
Bug fixes, correctness improvements, and optimizations

request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the vendor MLabs
request.what: Annual funding for maintenance and enhancement of MLabs' Plutarch and Ply Cardano smart contract tooling, including compatibility work, bug fixes, optimizations, documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements.

claims.claim: Plutarch is a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts through controlled compilation into UPLC.
Ply serializes Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types to protect the on-chain/off-chain boundary.
MLabs counted at least 26 teams building with Plutarch and Ply in a recent internal audit, while the rationale later describes at least 15 teams as a conservative count.
MLabs' public cross-language benchmarks show Plutarch scripts ranking among the smallest in the benchmark suite while using comparatively low on-chain compute and memory.
The requested 1,162,746 ada consists of 1,128,880 ada for Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility, and developer experience plus a 33,866 ada Intersect administration fee.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount did not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties.

Treasury funds would be administered through Intersect's 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract, with specified multi-party authorization rules involving Intersect admins, Intersect leadership, and an external Oversight Committee.

MLabs previously received Project Catalyst and Intersect funding for Plutarch/Ply-related work and other tooling proposals, including Fund9 USD 73,040, Fund13 ADA 487,679, Fund13 ADA 57,370, and ADA 70,000 from Intersect for Conway-era Plutarch updates.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ada for one annual maintenance and enhancement package for Plutarch and Ply, submitted by Intersect on behalf of MLabs, with stated adoption, performance, governance-process, NCL, prior-funding, and smart-contract oversight claims.
